2610.11373.title: From a Prompt to Repertoires: Evolving Functional REpertoires Enable LLM Continual Learning
2610.11373.paper_summary: Continual learning remains challenging for large language models, which must enable models to acquire new skills and knowledge without degrading existing capabilities. Existing approaches typically address this challenge by carefully designing how model parameters are updated. In contrast, prompt optimization avoids costly parameter updates while achieving competitive or even superior performance to reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO on individual knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks. This raises a natural question: \textit{Can prompt optimization, as an efficient adaptation approach, be directly applied to continual learning?} Our analysis shows that, under sequential task adaptation, it suffers from catastrophic forgetting, while optimized prompts accumulate rules that overfit to local task distributions. To address these limitations, we propose \emph{Evolving Functional REpertoires} (EFRE), which replaces a single prompt with a repertoire of functions that evolves as new tasks arrive: compatible updates refine existing functions, while conflicting updates trigger the emergence of new ones. On a three-task continual-learning stream, EFRE achieves a final average performance 7.50 percentage points higher than GRPO. Moreover, after adaptation to the Bio task, its performance on FinQA decreases by only 1.56 percentage points, compared with 25.10 percentage points for the base prompt optimization method. We further instantiate EFRE in a minimal agent system and observe consistent improvements across different backbone models. Overall, these results demonstrate EFRE's strong performance in continual learning for large language models and highlight its substantial potential for continual learning in advanced agent systems.
2610.11373.paper_summary_zh: 持續學習對大型語言模型來說仍然是一個挑戰，這些模型必須能夠在不降低現有能力的情況下獲得新技能和知識。現有的方法通常通過仔細設計模型參數的更新來解決這一挑戰。相比之下，提示優化避免了昂貴的參數更新，同時在個別知識密集和推理任務上實現了與強化學習方法（如GRPO）相當甚至更優的性能。這引發了一個自然的問題：\textit{作為一種高效的適應方法，提示優化能否直接應用於持續學習？} 我們的分析表明，在順序任務適應下，它遭遇了災難性遺忘，而優化的提示則累積了過度擬合於局部任務分佈的規則。為了解決這些局限性，我們提出了\emph{演變功能庫}（EFRE），它用一組隨著新任務到來而演變的函數來替代單一提示：相容的更新會細化現有函數，而衝突的更新則會觸發新函數的出現。在一個三任務的持續學習流中，EFRE的最終平均性能比GRPO高出7.50個百分點。此外，在適應Bio任務後，其在FinQA上的性能僅下降1.56個百分點，而基準提示優化方法的下降則為25.10個百分點。我們進一步在一個最小化的代理系統中實現EFRE，並觀察到不同骨幹模型之間的一致性改進。總體而言，這些結果展示了EFRE在大型語言模型持續學習中的強大性能，並突顯了其在先進代理系統中持續學習的潛在價值。
